privacy_intro_desc: Welcome to Taskify. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy_collect_intro: In this project, we collect the following data:
privacy_account_desc: Name and email address provided during signup.
privacy_task_desc: Content of tasks you create and manage.
privacy_cookie_desc: Technical cookies used to manage your login session and language preferences.
privacy_use_desc: Your data is used solely to provide task management services, including user authentication and personalized task lists. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy_security_desc: We implement technical measures to protect your data, including encrypted database storage and secure session management.
privacy_disclaimer_desc: This application is developed for CPT304 Software Engineering 2 coursework purposes at XJTLU. It is not a commercial product. Please do not upload sensitive real-world personal data.
